metadata.dcterms:title: CHARACTER VARIETIES FOR SL(3, C): THE FIGURE EIGHT KNOT
metadata.dcterms:creator: FALBEL, E.
GUILLOUX, A.
KOSELEFF, P.-V.
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We give a description of several representation varieties of the fundamental group of the complement of the ﬁgure eight knot in PGL(3, C) or PSL(3, C). We obtain a description of the projection of the representation variety into the character variety of the boundary torus into SL(3, C).
